objective: Proof: states of a weave disc as height functions; the extension lemma; the cyclic criterion for constrained sets; D(x,y) + D(y,x) = 3 steps apart; b >= steps apart + 1.
status: Proved 2026-11-18 (referee pending): on weave patches without holes, states are height functions; a set is constrained exactly when m >= 3 of its members have a cyclic order of height-distance sum at most 3(m - 2); D(x,y) + D(y,x) = 3 steps apart (no level knot, via cited bridged-graph theorems); every bond holding x != y has at least steps + 2 members, so bond distance is at least steps apart + 1.
title: Heights, the criterion and the lower bound
